items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The term 'Lydian' refers to the 'Lydian Chromatic Concept of Tonal Organization' (a book/theory by George Russell himself), not a person. The interviewer uses it as a shorthand for Russell's work/concept.

ctx.x: So we got married. It was kind of a thing where I said – that happened for about a year. She worked. I didn’t have anything. I worked at this.
Yeah, and I told her that at one point she wouldn’t have to work anymore, that this is going to make it.
